senses.gloss: (mostly with דָּם) to let blood; to be bled.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 5:2">Bekh. V, 2</cite> <he>אין מַקִּיזִין לו דם</he> you must not bleed it; <he>יַקִּיז</he> one may &c.
<cite ref="Shabbat 129a:10">Sabb. 129ᵃ</cite> <he>ה׳ דם ונצטנן</he> if one feels chilly after having been bled.
<cite ref="Shabbat 129b:2">Ib. 129ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ דם ועמד</he> if one stands up after &c.
<cite ref="Nedarim 54b:5">Ned. 54ᵇ</cite> <he>אין מקיזין על וכ׳</he> you must not be bled after having eaten &c.
<cite ref="Sotah 22b:3">Sot. 22ᵇ</cite> (expl. <he>פרוש קיזאי</he>) <he>המַקִּיז דם לכתלים</he> who bleeds himself by striking against the walls (walking with closed eyes from sanctimoniousness).
<cite ref="Berakhot 60a:28">Ber. 60ᵃ</cite> <he>הנכנס להַקִּיז דם</he> he who enters (the surgeon’s office) to be bled; a. fr.
